headline: Manifold Tech Limited and FARO INSIGHT Partner to Expand Reality Capture into New Markets
summary: Manifold Tech Limited, a spatial intelligence technology company, announced a strategic collaboration with FARO INSIGHT, a business of AMETEK, Inc. The collaboration's first result is Rovi i.1, a mobile reality capture solution designed for everyday field use.

headline: AMETEK’s (AME) $5B Deal Bets Big On A Hot Streak
summary: On August 26, AMETEK (NYSE:AME) closed one of the largest deals in its history, an all-cash purchase of Indicor Instrumentation for $5.0 billion. The timing is notable.
